hero.description:
Sketch of engagement at Bayou Fourche, Arkansas, fought September 10, 1863, between the Confederate forces under Major General Price and the United States forces under Major General Steele. To accompany report of Col. John M. Glover, Third Missouri Cavalry.Higher-resolution version at the David Rumsey Historical Map Collection
